## overview

**What is the main idea behind the product?**

Everything in EatLabs shares one guest record. So a call, a WhatsApp message, a booking and a bill all land on the same profile, and your host knows who is walking in.

**What modules do I get?**

There are thirteen modules — AI calls, reservations and floor, WhatsApp, guest CRM, AI menu and QR dining, loyalty and offers, WhatsApp campaigns, reviews and feedback, events and ticketing, Zomato and Swiggy data, insights, a business suite, multi-outlet tools and a staff app.

**How many modules are there?**

There are thirteen modules — AI calls, reservations and floor, WhatsApp, guest CRM, AI menu and QR dining, loyalty and offers, WhatsApp campaigns, reviews and feedback, events and ticketing, Zomato and Swiggy data, insights, a business suite, multi-outlet tools and a staff app.

**Where can bookings come from?**

Bookings come in from the AI phone host, WhatsApp, Instagram, your website, Reserve with Google, Zomato, Swiggy, walk-ins and events — and they all check the same availability.

**Which languages are supported?**

English, Hindi and Kannada — and the AI follows guests who mix them, like Hinglish.

**Does it handle Hinglish?**

English, Hindi and Kannada — and the AI follows guests who mix them, like Hinglish.

**What does EatLabs not do?**

EatLabs doesn't replace your staff and it doesn't handle your money. Your team answers the phone first — the AI covers what they miss. And payments go straight to your own Razorpay account.

## ai-calls

**What happens when nobody answers the phone?**

If your phone rings during service and nobody can pick up, EatLabs answers, books the table and tells your host what happened.

> ⚠ answered from `segments-objections#segment-1-busy-single-restaurants`, not the intended `ai-calls#what-the-ai-phone-host-does`.

**Does the AI answer calls when we are closed?**

No. Your team answers first. The AI only covers missed calls, peak hours and the times you're closed.

**Can the AI pass a call to a human?**

There's one calls screen showing today's calls, missed ones, what the AI handled, and callbacks that are due — with one-tap call back.

> ⚠ answered from `ai-calls#the-calls-screen`, not the intended `ai-calls#warm-transfer-to-staff`.

**What happens to a call that is still missed?**

Any call that still gets missed automatically gets a WhatsApp message back with a booking link that already has their number filled in.

**Where do I see today's calls?**

There's one calls screen showing today's calls, missed ones, what the AI handled, and callbacks that are due — with one-tap call back.

**Do you record calls?**

Your profile, call recordings, transcripts and loyalty balance are deleted outright. Bookings stay but with your name and number stripped, so the restaurant's record of how busy a night was doesn't change. Tax records stay eight years with personal fields stripped, as Indian law requires.

> ⚠ answered from `guest-rights#what-gets-deleted-and-what-must-stay`, not the intended `ai-calls#call-records-recording-and-transcripts`.

**How long do you keep call recordings?**

Calls are recorded only if you turn it on, and callers are told. Recordings are kept 90 days by default, and sensitive numbers are stripped out of transcripts before they're stored.

**Can the AI cancel someone else's booking?**

The AI can check availability and take or change the caller's own booking. It cannot cancel someone else's booking or issue a refund — those controls simply aren't connected to it.

**Can I turn the AI answering off?**

Answering mode is set per outlet. You can run hunt-group only, a normal IVR, or AI answering — and recording, AI replies and the bot each switch off independently.

**Can I keep my existing phone number?**

We can give you a number, or you can port or point your existing one at the platform.

## reservations

**Can two channels book the same table?**

Every channel checks the same availability engine, and it's enforced in the database. Two channels physically cannot take the same table.

**How do you prevent double bookings?**

Every channel checks the same availability engine, and it's enforced in the database. Two channels physically cannot take the same table.

**Is there a floor plan view?**

There's a visual floor plan with live table status pulled from your POS — you drag to seat, see turn times, and block zones for events.

**Do you have a waitlist?**

Guests join the waitlist on WhatsApp, the web, or a QR code at the door. They see their position in the queue and get a message the moment a table is ready.

**Do guests get a reminder before they come?**

Confirmations, updates and cancellations go out automatically, plus reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before with Confirm or Cancel buttons. If WhatsApp can't deliver, it falls back to SMS.

**Can I take a deposit to stop no-shows?**

You can require a deposit by party size, day, shift or date. Guests pay by UPI or card on Razorpay, and refunds follow your policy automatically.

**How do guests pay a deposit?**

You can require a deposit by party size, day, shift or date. Guests pay by UPI or card on Razorpay, and refunds follow your policy automatically.

**Do you support multiple outlets?**

A guest who eats at Indiranagar should be recognised in Koramangala. One profile per guest, one points balance, across every outlet.

## menu

**Do you have a QR menu?**

A QR menu at the table with no app to download, in English, Hindi and Kannada, with diet filters and an AI food concierge.

Guests can ask for something like "not spicy, veg, under four hundred rupees". Diet and allergy rules are checked in code, not left to the AI — and if the kitchen hasn't confirmed a dish's allergens, it's never suggested to someone avoiding that allergen.

## security

**Where is my data stored?**

All guest and account data is stored in India, in the AWS Mumbai region, and it's designed for the DPDP Act. There's no cross-region replication of personal data.

**Is guest data kept in India?**

All guest and account data is stored in India, in the AWS Mumbai region, and it's designed for the DPDP Act. There's no cross-region replication of personal data.

**Does anything leave India?**

Only three things leave India — the AI model inference, WhatsApp delivery through Meta, and reading back your own Google and Meta business stats.

**How is access controlled?**

Role-based access across around 290 API routes, checked automatically on every release. All connected-account keys are encrypted, and every refund, point change and review reply is logged with who did it and when.

**Can another restaurant see my guests?**

One restaurant's guest data is never visible to another, and that's enforced at the database level, not by convention.

**Can your staff look at my customer data?**

Our staff don't browse your data. Support access needs a time-boxed session with a stated reason and a ticket reference, every record read is logged, and the account owner is notified.

**Who is the data fiduciary?**

For guest data you are the Data Fiduciary and we are your processor — you decide what's collected and why, we process it on your instructions.

**Which sub-processors do you use?**

We use AWS for hosting in Mumbai, Razorpay for payments, Plivo and Exotel for calls — all in India — plus Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, which process outside India.

**Does EatLabs hold my money?**

Money doesn't pass through us. You connect your own Razorpay account, guests pay on Razorpay's hosted page, and it settles straight to your bank.

**How do payments work?**

Money doesn't pass through us. You connect your own Razorpay account, guests pay on Razorpay's hosted page, and it settles straight to your bank.

**How long do you keep booking data?**

Call recordings and transcripts, 90 days by default. Bookings, two years then personal fields are stripped. Tax records, eight years, as GST requires.

**What do you do if there is a data breach?**

We assess any breach within 24 hours and notify the Data Protection Board and affected people where the DPDP Act requires it.

**What is your uptime guarantee?**

We don't publish a general uptime percentage — if you need a committed figure, it goes in your order form. Support is by WhatsApp, phone and email, with priority for an outlet that can't take bookings at all.

**Can you share a DPIA?**

We can share a data-processing summary and a DPIA — ask for them on the demo call.

**Which law governs the contract?**

Indian law, with the courts at Bengaluru having exclusive jurisdiction.

## guest-rights

**What rights do I have under the DPDP Act?**

You can ask for a copy of your data, have it corrected, have it erased, withdraw consent for marketing, nominate someone to act for you, or complain to our grievance officer.

**How do I delete my data?**

There's no form to hunt for and no account to log into. Email privacy at eatlabs dot in, or WhatsApp or call +91 80 4000 1200. Use the subject line "Data deletion request".

**Delete my data**

There's no form to hunt for and no account to log into. Email privacy at eatlabs dot in, or WhatsApp or call +91 80 4000 1200. Use the subject line "Data deletion request".

**What should I include in a deletion request?**

Four things — the phone number you used with the restaurant, the restaurant's name, what you want deleted, and a way to reply to you. You don't have to give a reason.

**How will you check it is really me?**

We send a one-time code to the number on the record. If that number no longer works, we'll find another way — a payment reference, or the date and time of a booking.

**How long does deletion take?**

We acknowledge within 72 hours, usually verify the same day, and deletion runs across every store within 7 days of verification.

**What exactly gets deleted?**

Your profile, call recordings, transcripts and loyalty balance are deleted outright. Bookings stay but with your name and number stripped, so the restaurant's record of how busy a night was doesn't change. Tax records stay eight years with personal fields stripped, as Indian law requires.

**I only want the marketing to stop, not everything**

If the problem is just marketing, you don't need deletion. Tap opt-out on any marketing WhatsApp message or reply STOP to a marketing SMS. It takes effect immediately across every channel, and your bookings and points stay as they are.

**Does the restaurant or EatLabs handle my request?**

Four things — the phone number you used with the restaurant, the restaurant's name, what you want deleted, and a way to reply to you. You don't have to give a reason.

> ⚠ answered from `guest-rights#what-to-include-in-the-request`, not the intended `guest-rights#requests-routed-to-the-restaurant`.

**Do you use tracking cookies?**

The marketing site uses only a session cookie for forms and Google Analytics. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

## segments

**My phone rings during service and nobody picks up**

If your phone rings during service and nobody can pick up, EatLabs answers, books the table and tells your host what happened.

**We run three outlets, does that work?**

Groups get one booking page across every outlet — guests pick a location and book in three taps.

> ⚠ answered from `reservations#multi-outlet-reservations`, not the intended `segments-objections#segment-2-restaurant-groups`.

**We are a bar with ticketed nights**

If you run events, gigs and ticketed nights — sell tickets on WhatsApp, check guests in by QR, and never double-book a table an event already holds.

**Which POS systems do you support?**

Petpooja, Posist and others through a webhook or CSV import. Payments through your own Razorpay. WhatsApp through Meta. Google and Instagram for reviews and ads.

**Does it work with Petpooja?**

Petpooja, Posist and others through a webhook or CSV import. Payments through your own Razorpay. WhatsApp through Meta. Google and Instagram for reviews and ads.

**Will the AI replace my staff?**

No. Your team answers first. The AI only covers missed calls, peak hours and the times you're closed.

**Do my guests need to download an app?**

No. Booking, the menu, the waitlist and tickets all open in the browser.

**Can the AI get something wrong?**

Yes, it can — it's a language model, so you should review anything that goes out in your name. That's why review replies are drafted for your approval rather than published automatically.

**What if our internet goes down?**

The staff app keeps working offline and syncs when you're back. And we'd tell you honestly — we run in one Indian region, so you should be able to fall back to a printed agenda for a service.

**How quickly can we go live?**

A single restaurant can be live in a day, with no code needed, and the trial is set up with our onboarding team.
